verdict.rationale: Bruno is offline-only with no cloud sync, account, or login. It stores collections as plain-text files in a filesystem folder the user picks, so the user decides where data lives. Bruno AI is bring-your-own-key, routes no data through Bruno servers, and can point at self-hosted or local models. Community users corroborate the local-file model and the value of not keeping credentials in an external cloud. Missing for 10: explicit documentation framing this as data residency or region control; any residency guarantees for shared or Git-hosted data, which depend on the user's chosen remote.
